newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Placer Pac. advises no action on bid.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Placer Pac. advises no action on bid.

text.p: Placer Pacific Ltd said on Thursday shareholders should take no action on a bid by its Canadian parent Placer Dome Inc.

"The board advises that the would be prudent for Placer Pacific shareholders to consider the formal documentation which Placer Dome will send them and Placer Pacific's Part B Statement (which will include the independent experts report and will also be sent to shareholders) before deciding whether or not to accept the offer or otherwise dispose of their shares," Placer Pacific said in a statement.

Placer Dome is offering one of its shares for every 15 Placer Pacific shares. The Canadian company is bidding for the 24.6 percent of the Australian offshoot that it does not already own. -- Sydney Newsroom 61-2 9373-1800
